# Job Description - Infrastructure Architect

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Resources](../../README.md) • [Job Descriptions](../README.md)**

---

> **Position**: Infrastructure Architect
> **Department**: Enterprise Architecture Practice
> **Reports To**: Senior Enterprise Architect
> **Location**: Remote/Hybrid
> **Classification**: Full-time

---
page_texts.2:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#position-summary]

## Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Architect to join our Enterprise Architecture Practice (EAP) team. This role will design and lead the implementation of infrastructure and technology platform architectures for Gainwell Technologies' healthcare portfolio, including cloud infrastructure, on-premises systems, networking, and emerging technology platforms, ensuring scalable, secure, and compliant solutions that support our digital transformation initiatives while meeting healthcare regulatory requirements.

---
page_texts.4:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#infrastructure--technology-strategy]

### Infrastructure & Technology Strategy

- Design enterprise infrastructure and technology architecture strategy aligned with business objectives and ERA principles
- Develop cloud-first and hybrid architectural patterns and standards for healthcare applications
- Create multi-cloud, hybrid cloud, and on-premises infrastructure strategies for healthcare system modernization
- Establish infrastructure governance frameworks and operational excellence practices
- Define technology platform strategies including emerging technologies and innovation initiatives
page_texts.5:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#healthcare-infrastructure-solutions]

### Healthcare Infrastructure Solutions

- Design cloud-native and hybrid infrastructure solutions for Medicaid, CHIP, and other government healthcare programs
- Architect scalable and resilient healthcare platforms on AWS, Azure, and on-premises infrastructure
- Implement infrastructure solutions that meet HIPAA and FedRAMP compliance requirements
- Design infrastructure for interoperability solutions using X12 EDI, NCPDP, FHIR, HL7, and other healthcare standards
page_texts.6:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#cloud-migration--modernization]

### Cloud Migration & Modernization

- Lead cloud and infrastructure migration strategies for legacy healthcare systems
- Design application modernization approaches including containerization and microservices
- Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and DevOps practices for healthcare applications
- Support digital transformation initiatives through cloud and modern infrastructure technology adoption
page_texts.7:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#platform--infrastructure-design]

### Platform & Infrastructure Design

- Design infrastructure architectures including compute, storage, networking, and security (cloud and on-premises)
- Implement platform services for healthcare data processing, analytics, and emerging technologies
- Design disaster recovery and business continuity solutions across multiple environments
- Architect auto-scaling and performance optimization strategies
page_texts.8:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#devops--infrastructure-automation]

### DevOps & Infrastructure Automation

- Design CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows for healthcare applications
- Implement infrastructure automation and configuration management
- Design monitoring, logging, and observability solutions for healthcare systems
- Support containerization strategies using Docker and Kubernetes

---
page_texts.10:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#education]

### Education

- **Minimum**: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field
- **Preferred**: Master's degree in relevant technical field or cloud computing specialization
page_texts.11:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#experience]

### Experience

- **Required**: 6+ years of experience in infrastructure architecture and platform implementation
- **Required**: 3+ years of experience with healthcare applications and compliance requirements
- **Preferred**: 4+ years of experience in government or regulated industry infrastructure implementations
page_texts.13:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#infrastructure--cloud-platform-expertise]

#### Infrastructure & Cloud Platform Expertise

- Advanced proficiency in AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, EKS, etc.)
- Advanced proficiency in Azure services (VMs, Storage, SQL Database, Functions, AKS, etc.)
- Multi-cloud, hybrid, and on-premises infrastructure architecture design
- Infrastructure cost optimization and resource management
- Networking architecture (VPCs, load balancers, CDNs, DNS)
page_texts.14:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#healthcare-infrastructure-compliance]

#### Healthcare Infrastructure Compliance

- FedRAMP compliance implementation and management
- HIPAA compliance for cloud healthcare solutions
- Healthcare data residency and sovereignty requirements
- Government cloud security frameworks and controls
page_texts.15:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#devops--automation]

#### DevOps & Automation

- Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM templates)
- CI/CD pipeline design and implementation (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab)
- Container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker Swarm)
- Configuration management (Ansible, Puppet, Chef)
page_texts.16:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#architecture--integration]

#### Architecture & Integration

- Microservices architecture and API gateway patterns
- Serverless computing and event-driven architectures
- Cloud data architecture and analytics platforms
- Integration patterns for cloud and on-premises systems
page_texts.17:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#documentation--ai-tools]

#### Documentation & AI Tools

- Markdown and documentation-as-code practices for technical documentation
- Experience with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Amazon CodeWhisperer, etc.)
- Generative AI tools for cloud architecture design and automation
- AI agents and automation tools for infrastructure and DevOps workflows
page_texts.19:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#required]

#### Required

- **One of**: AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
page_texts.20:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#preferred]

#### Preferred

- AWS Security Specialty or Azure Security Engineer Associate
- Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD)
- DevOps or site reliability engineering certifications

---
page_texts.22:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#specialized-cloud-experience]

### Specialized Cloud Experience

- Experience with healthcare-specific cloud services and platforms
- Knowledge of Medicaid Management Information Systems (MMIS) cloud modernization
- Understanding of healthcare interoperability cloud solutions
- Experience with AI/ML platforms for healthcare analytics
page_texts.23:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#advanced-cloud-technologies]

### Advanced Cloud Technologies

- Serverless architecture design and implementation
- Edge computing and IoT solutions for healthcare
- Blockchain implementation on cloud platforms
- Advanced analytics and data lake architectures
- Experience with cloud-based Generative AI services and platforms (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, etc.)
page_texts.24:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#industry--compliance]

### Industry & Compliance

- Experience with state government cloud procurement and contracting
- Knowledge of healthcare audit and compliance processes
- Understanding of disaster recovery and business continuity in healthcare
- Experience with cloud financial management and FinOps practices

---
page_texts.26:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#technical-competencies]

### Technical Competencies

- **Cloud Architecture**: Expertise in designing scalable, resilient cloud solutions
- **Automation**: Advanced skills in infrastructure and deployment automation
- **Performance Optimization**: Ability to optimize cloud performance and costs
- **Integration**: Skills in designing cloud integration and migration strategies
page_texts.27:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#business-competencies]

### Business Competencies

- **Healthcare Domain**: Understanding of healthcare workflows and technology requirements
- **Cost Management**: Expertise in cloud cost optimization and financial management
- **Compliance Management**: Knowledge of healthcare and government compliance requirements
- **Vendor Management**: Experience with cloud vendor relationships and procurement
page_texts.28:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#leadership-competencies]

### Leadership Competencies

- **Technical Leadership**: Ability to lead cloud transformation initiatives
- **Innovation**: Capability to identify and implement emerging cloud technologies
- **Change Management**: Skills in leading organizational cloud adoption
- **Mentoring**: Ability to develop cloud skills in technical teams

---
page_texts.30:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#cloud-solution-delivery]

### Cloud Solution Delivery

- Design and implement robust cloud architectures for healthcare systems
- Ensure cloud solutions meet performance, security, and compliance requirements
- Support successful cloud migrations and modernization projects
- Maintain cloud architecture documentation and operational procedures
page_texts.31:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/infrastructure-architect.md#innovation--optimization]

### Innovation & Optimization

- Drive adoption of new cloud services and capabilities
- Implement cost optimization and performance improvement initiatives
- Support automation and DevOps maturity across healthcare applications
- Contribute to cloud architecture standards and best practices
